dict.string: Farstep captures your screen to let your authorized agent see and control your desktop
Farstep sends keyboard and pointer input for your authorized desktop sessions
Farstep runs automation requested by your agent in other applications
Farstep installs system access and configures its application firewall rules
Farstep jobs access files on your Desktop at your request
Farstep jobs access your Documents at your request
Farstep jobs access your Downloads at your request
Farstep jobs access your mounted network volumes at your request
Farstep jobs access your removable volumes at your request
